summary: E-Power Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq under EPOW, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a 25:1 share consolidation approved by shareholders on September 4, 2026. Authorized capital falls from 5,000,000,000 ordinary shares at US$0.0001 par to 200,000,000 shares at US$0.0025 par, split 140,000,000 Class A and 60,000,000 Class B. Outstanding shares drop from 58,170,835 to roughly 2,326,834; trading begins post-consolidation September 18, 2026, with a new CUSIP G3091B102. Fractional shares round up; no cash paid. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
